name: DropZone
summary: Accepts files dragged or pasted into a bounded drop target.

useWhen: Collecting files by drag and drop or paste
avoidWhen: Selecting a file from a native picker only

obligations: Expose a keyboard- and pointer-operable drop target.
Expose disabled state and focus indication.

behavior: Pointer, keyboard, and clipboard input all reach the same onDrop callback.
onDrop receives the dropped items as a list of file, directory, and text items, not a File array.
A file item reads with getFile, which resolves a File, or getText, which resolves its text.
A text item reads with getText and one of the formats listed in its types.
A directory item lists its contents with getEntries, an async iterator of file and directory items.
Reads are asynchronous, and DropZone does not catch a failed read.
DropZone does not filter items by kind or type; every dropped item arrives.
onActivate runs when the drop target's own hidden button is activated.
Clicks on controls inside DropZone, such as a FileTrigger, do not call onActivate.
DropZone reads no browser globals during server rendering.
accessibility: Expose a keyboard drop affordance alongside pointer and clipboard input.
Expose disabled state on the drop button and visible-focus state, and preserve the consumer-provided accessible name; the role-less root carries data-disabled for styling only.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
